values would need to take up the same amount of space. But they have different lengths:
needs 15. This is why it’s not possible to create a variable holding a dynamically sized type.

In general, this is the way in which dynamically sized types are used in Rust: They have an extra bit of metadata that stores the size of the dynamic information.
